facts.title: The editor saves 'Win: every objective done' switched ON with zero inputs when no objective has a completing trigger (keep-alive only), and the mission wins at load
facts.fact: Editor app_tabs.cpp:2600-2613 sets the win trigger's TriggerEnabled from want.empty only inside 'if (have != want)'; a new MATriggerLogic (triggers.cpp:1022 gives TriggerEnabled 1) with no completers has have == want == empty, so it stays enabled with 0 inputs. Keep-alive objectives never have a completer. Proven: mapB3 + the box ticked, saved by the released editor = MATriggerLogic 'Win: every objective done' TriggerEnabled 1, 0 MoeEntityReference; quick-test: '[text omitted]', hub menu 00481B70 (win). The same map with TriggerEnabled 0 plays 45 s. Check scenario (scenario.cpp:2200) already blocks Test for it, but a saved mission started from Custom Scenarios wins at once.
facts.how_to_use: Fix (editor): keep TriggerEnabled in step with want.empty on every sync pass, not only when the inputs change. Repro: the audit notes

facts.title: A unit removed by 'Remove units' (or any watched UID that no longer resolves) counts as destroyed for MATriggerDestroyed
facts.fact: sub_001491EF with TypeOfCheck 1 looks up each MoeEntityReference ReferenceUID with sub_000B4F70 (recomp_0033.c:4897); a failed lookup goes to the walker sub_001494AC with a null entity (4902 -> 4916-4922), which increments the checked count +0xC8 and returns 1 = destroyed (5231-5242). Game-proven: a keep-alive (Any, Damage 0, Lose) on a live friendly Hackman plays 55 s; with a timer that removes the unit at 12 s the mission is lost at 12 s on every start (AllowJacking 0 or 1 alike). A deleted or stale watched UID therefore fires the trigger at load.
facts.how_to_use: Do not use Remove units on a unit a Lose trigger watches unless the loss is wanted.
